name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. A former aircraft mechanic, he transitioned to Formula 1 after a chance encounter with a Williams engineer at a local pub quiz in Grove. His meticulous approach to aircraft assembly translated seamlessly to the intricate world of composite materials, where precision is paramount. He quickly established himself as a dependable member of the team, earning respect for his unwavering commitment to quality and his ability to troubleshoot complex composite issues under pressure.

Rhys approaches his role with a quiet dedication, often spending extra hours ensuring every component meets his exacting standards. He's known for his encyclopedic knowledge of carbon fiber weaves and resin types, and his ability to diagnose subtle imperfections that others might miss. While not one to seek the spotlight, Rhys finds immense satisfaction in knowing that his work contributes to the team's overall performance and safety. His loyalty to Williams is unwavering, having turned down offers from rival teams throughout his career.

physical.description: Rhys is a stocky man with kind eyes and a weathered face that speaks of long hours dedicated to his craft.

quirks: Always wears a Williams Racing cap, even indoors.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workbench before starting any task.
Carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes on composite materials and techniques.
